# Infinity SoftHub Technologies

> Founder-led custom LMS development company based in Faridabad, India, delivering remotely worldwide. We build Moodle™, LearnDash and IOMAD learning platforms, custom LMS plugins and themes, interactive SQL & Python coding labs, AI learning assistants (RAG, OpenAI/Claude/Gemini), LMS integrations, migrations and cloud hosting.

Moodle™ is a registered trademark of Moodle Pty Ltd. Infinity SoftHub is an independent development agency, not affiliated with Moodle Pty Ltd.

## Core LMS services
- [LMS & Moodle Development](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/moodle-all-development.php): End-to-end custom LMS builds, plugins, themes, integrations and deployment.
- [Custom Moodle Plugins & Integrations](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/moodle-development.php): Plugin engineering, coding playgrounds, AI study assistants, theme design.
- [IOMAD Multi-Tenant LMS](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/iomad-multi-tenant-lms.php): Multi-company / multi-tenant training platforms.
- [Enterprise LMS & Corporate Training](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/lms-solutions.php): SCORM-compliant corporate training, onboarding portals, virtual classrooms.
- [LearnDash Development](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/learndash-development.php): WordPress LMS builds, quizzes, certificates, course selling.
- [Mobile e-Learning](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/mobile-elearning.php): Responsive LMS, offline access, microlearning, LMS mobile apps.
- [AI & ML LMS Integration](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/ai-ml-integration.php): RAG-based learning assistants, course Q&A, PDF Q&A.
- [Interactive SQL Coding Lab (demo)](https://infinitysofthub.com/demos/sql-playground.php): Browser-based SQL lab with auto-grading for Moodle & LearnDash.
- [LMS Hosting, Setup & Migration](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/hosting-migration.php): AWS/Azure hosting, upgrades, zero-downtime migrations, backups.
- [LMS Security](https://infinitysofthub.com/services/security-solutions.php): SSL, data protection, compliance, monitoring.
